name: Cloud World Model — Agent API
description: Agent-facing discovery API for Cloud World Model: 54 operations across 50 paths, including 48 metered operations with x402 prices and six operations without a per-call x402 price (wallet challenge and verification, scenario listing, x402 configuration, analysis-job lookup, and AI-job cancellation). Some read and status operations are metered; do not assume all reads are free. Check each operation's x402 price or GET /billing/x402/config for current prices. Anonymous callers can pay for metered requests with USDC on Base via `X-PAYMENT`, or optional Solana USDC via `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` when advertised by the config endpoint — no account or API key is required for x402 payment.
